name: Maya
summary: Optional scenario from the brief: a cautious investor preparing for a near-term purchase. Junior designer saving for a condo down payment; says market drops 'don't stress her'.
objective: Buy a condo in about 2.5 years; long-term retirement savings on the side.
risk_tolerance_note: High self-declared tolerance, but has never lived through a bear market with real money. Tests tolerance vs capacity.
sample_requests: Move $15,000 of my condo savings from ZST into QQQ, tech always goes up.
Put $10,000 of my condo money into Bitcoin.
Add $3,000 of new money to SPY for retirement.
